main.description: Post to the caller's own Bluesky account: an `app.bsky.feed.post` written into their repo, on their PDS, with the grant their login left with this AppView. Where the text contains `url`, it becomes a link; `url` always rides along as a link card. Only a page of this app can be the card.

uri.description: The post, in the caller's repo.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No text, more than 300 characters, or a card for somewhere else.

errors.name: PdsRefused
errors.description: The caller's PDS did not take the post, usually because the grant has lapsed; signing in again renews it (HTTP 409).

errors.name: OAuthNotConfigured
errors.description: This AppView has no OAuth client (HTTP 503).
